summary: Banco Santander (Brasil) S.A. filed a Form 6-K furnishing minutes of an October 30, 2026 Board of Directors meeting. Directors unanimously elected Daniel Bassan as an Executive Vice-President Officer for a complementary term, recommended by the Nomination and Governance Committee, effective on assumption of office on January 26, 2027, subject to prior approval by the Central Bank of Brazil (or later approval date). This is a routine board election of an officer rather than a forced or abrupt departure event. No commercial terms, advisors, or deadlines beyond the regulatory approval condition apply; the risk-arb angle is nil.
